title: 基因法分片：把 user_id 基因位嵌进 order_id
expected_output:
=== 基因法分片：把 user_id 的基因位嵌进 order_id ===
基因位 = 4（2^4 = 16 个分片），用户数 = 200，每用户订单数 = 5，订单总数 = 1000
order_id = (全局自增序号 << 4) | (user_id & 0b1111)

[正例] 按 order_id % 16 分片 == 按 user_id % 16 分片 : 1000/1000 -> True
[正例] order_id 全局唯一 : 1000/1000 -> True

[正例] 同一用户的订单全落同一分片 : 跨分片用户数 = 0 / 200

[反例] 不嵌基因位，直接按自增 order_seq % 16 分片
       跨分片用户数 = 200 / 200
       同用户同分片 : False

示例：user_id=37 -> 基因 = 37 & 15 = 5
  order_id = 2885                   -> shard = 5
  order_id = 2901                   -> shard = 5
  order_id = 2917                   -> shard = 5
  order_id = 2933                   -> shard = 5
  order_id = 2949                   -> shard = 5

收益：按订单号分片的规则下，仍保证「同用户数据同分片」，
     用户维度查询只需打 1 个分片；代价是 order_id 低 4 位不再是纯自增（生成器要多做一次或运算）。
code:
GENE_BITS = 4
MASK = (1 << GENE_BITS) - 1
SHARDS = 1 << GENE_BITS

USERS = list(range(1, 201))
PER_USER = 5

orders = []
seq = 0
for u in USERS:
    for _ in range(PER_USER):
        gene = u & MASK
        oid = (seq << GENE_BITS) | gene
        orders.append((u, oid, seq))
        seq += 1

print("=== 基因法分片：把 user_id 的基因位嵌进 order_id ===")
print("基因位 = %d（2^%d = %d 个分片），用户数 = %d，每用户订单数 = %d，订单总数 = %d"
      % (GENE_BITS, GENE_BITS, SHARDS, len(USERS), PER_USER, len(orders)))
print("order_id = (全局自增序号 << %d) | (user_id & 0b1111)" % GENE_BITS)
print()

same = sum(1 for u, oid, _ in orders if (oid & MASK) == (u & MASK))
uniq = len(set(o for _, o, _ in orders))
print("[正例] 按 order_id %% %d 分片 == 按 user_id %% %d 分片 : %d/%d -> %s"
      % (SHARDS, SHARDS, same, len(orders), same == len(orders)))
print("[正例] order_id 全局唯一 : %d/%d -> %s" % (uniq, len(orders), uniq == len(orders)))
print()

by_user = {}
for u, oid, _ in orders:
    by_user.setdefault(u, set()).add(oid & MASK)
split_gene = sum(1 for s in by_user.values() if len(s) > 1)
print("[正例] 同一用户的订单全落同一分片 : 跨分片用户数 = %d / %d" % (split_gene, len(by_user)))
print()

by_user_raw = {}
for u, _, raw in orders:
    by_user_raw.setdefault(u, set()).add(raw & MASK)
split_raw = sum(1 for s in by_user_raw.values() if len(s) > 1)
print("[反例] 不嵌基因位，直接按自增 order_seq %% %d 分片" % SHARDS)
print("       跨分片用户数 = %d / %d" % (split_raw, len(by_user_raw)))
print("       同用户同分片 : %s" % (split_raw == 0))
print()

u0 = 37
print("示例：user_id=%d -> 基因 = %d & %d = %d" % (u0, u0, MASK, u0 & MASK))
for u, o, _ in orders:
    if u == u0:
        print("  order_id = %-22d -> shard = %d" % (o, o & MASK))
print()
print("收益：按订单号分片的规则下，仍保证「同用户数据同分片」，")
print("     用户维度查询只需打 1 个分片；代价是 order_id 低 %d 位不再是纯自增（生成器要多做一次或运算）。"
      % GENE_BITS)
